question: What does this comparison show, and what should be checked next?

protocol.evidence: The three held-out CHO deliveries of the offline trial, shared as provisional evidence; every arm starts from a fresh application holding the same deliveries.
protocol.scoring: Reference figures from the answer keys (largest difference, its time, mean difference, both batch names). No judge model. Figures are necessary for a right answer, not sufficient: reasoning needs a qualified reader.
protocol.timing: Time of the call that produces the answer, in process, one request per model call (no retries). A call during which the machine slept is kept in the rows, marked, and left out of the timing figures.
limits: Small sample; one attempt per case; differences between candidates are indications, not rankings.
Public laboratory data in fictional deliveries; not manufacturing validation.
Token counts are as reported by each provider; cost depends on your contract and is not estimated here.

rows.label: zai-org/GLM-5.3, low reasoning effort
rows.explanation: The comparison matches 11 exact-time glucose samples from CHO-004-R01 and CHO-004-R02; CHO-004-R02 runs lower at 9 of 11 times, with a mean difference of -0.2392 g/L and the largest gap of -0.944 g/L at 19.5 hours. No cause is established: product, process version, equipment, scale and process stage are all not recorded, and all values are provisional and still in review. Next, confirm the delivery review and record the missing context before interpreting the difference.
observations: CHO-004-R02 glucose is lower than CHO-004-R01 at 9 of 11 matched times (mean difference -0.2392 g/L, largest -0.944 g/L at 19.5 h).
Matches span 0.0 to 142.0 elapsed hours, with 1 unmatched CHO-004-R01 sample at 164.0 h.
Product, process version, equipment, scale and process stage are not recorded for either batch.
All values come from a provisional delivery with 55 open checks, of which 47 are missing field.

hypotheses.statement: The lower CHO-004-R02 glucose profile reflects a different process condition, such as equipment or process version.
hypotheses.check: Record and compare the missing context attributes for both batches.

hypotheses.statement: The differences are artifacts of unreviewed or incomplete delivery data.
hypotheses.check: Complete the delivery review and re-run the comparison on verified values.

hypotheses.statement: Glucose consumption in CHO-004-R02 proceeds faster, making profiles differ at fixed elapsed times.
hypotheses.check: Compare additional metabolite or cell-growth parameters measured in the same delivery.

unknowns: Whether the batches were made under comparable conditions, since context is not recorded.
Whether a single underlying cause explains the early-time gap at 19.5 h versus the small late-time differences.
Whether the unmatched CHO-004-R01 sample at 164.0 h indicates a longer or differently scheduled run.

rows.label: zai-org/GLM-5.3, low reasoning effort
rows.explanation: The comparison matches 16 exact sample times for viable cell density between CHO-004-R01 and CHO-004-R02, both running from 0.0 h to 212.0 h. CHO-004-R01 peaks higher (9930000 cells/mL at 142.0 h versus 8813333 cells/mL at 118.0 h), but the two batches diverge most around decline phase: differences swing from -2416667 cells/mL at 142.0 h to +2080000 cells/mL at 187.5 h. Values are provisional (in review, 47 open missing-field checks), and no context such as product, equipment, scale or process stage is recorded, so no cause can be attributed. Next, verify the delivery data and confirm the batch context before relying on this comparison.
observations: CHO-004-R01 reached 9930000 cells/mL at 142.0 h while CHO-004-R02 peaked at 8813333 cells/mL at 118.0 h, and CHO-004-R02 fell to 7513333 cells/mL at 142.0 h.
Differences (R02 minus R01) were positive in 12 of 16 matched samples before 118.0 h but reversed afterwards, ranging from -2416667 to 2080000 cells/mL with a mean of 89512.44 cells/mL.
Both series end at 212.0 h with CHO-004-R01 at 31467 cells/mL and CHO-004-R02 at 791667 cells/mL.
Product, process version, equipment, scale and process stage are not recorded for either batch, so the cohort verdict is not established.

hypotheses.statement: The two batches followed different growth or decline profiles because they were run under different equipment or process conditions.
hypotheses.check: Retrieve batch records to confirm equipment, scale and process version for CHO-004-R01 and CHO-004-R02.

hypotheses.statement: The provisional values include transcription or parsing errors, especially in the decline phase where the differences swing most.
hypotheses.check: Complete the 55 open verification checks on the delivery before using these values.

hypotheses.statement: The two batches peaked at genuinely different times and magnitudes, with CHO-004-R02 declining earlier.
hypotheses.check: Compare additional replicated batches of the same process to see whether the pattern repeats.

unknowns: Whether the compared conditions were equivalent, since no cohort attributes are recorded.
Whether the provisional measurements are accurate, as the delivery is still in review.
Why the batches diverge after 118.0 h, which this descriptive comparison cannot establish.

observations: Both batches peaked at 138 h, CHO-007-R01 at 11400000 cells/mL and CHO-007-R02 at 11066667 cells/mL, then declined to 1243333 and 1466667 cells/mL at 193 h.
The difference (R02 minus R01) changed sign repeatedly, with 42.86% of the 14 matched times positive and a median difference of -74500 cells/mL.
The largest single difference is 696666 cells/mL at 169 h, where CHO-007-R02 shows 6783333 cells/mL against 6086667 cells/mL for CHO-007-R01.
The delivery used is provisional, with 29 values still in review and 67 missing-field checks open, so these values are not yet accepted.

hypotheses.check: Review the raw assay records for the 146 h to 193 h samples in both batches.

hypotheses.check: Retrieve batch records and delivery documentation to confirm product, process version, equipment, scale and stage.

observations: CHO-010-R02 exceeded CHO-010-R01 at 193.5 h by 1.148 g/L (3.865 vs 2.717), the largest difference of the 16 matched times.

observations: All 23 sample times matched exactly between CHO-010-R01 and CHO-010-R02, with the largest negative difference at 233.5 h (-1467000 cells/mL) and the largest positive at 217.5 h (733300 cells/mL).
Both batches peak near 160.5-209 h (max 16070000 and 16170000 cells/mL) and decline to 2260000 and 1806667 cells/mL by 328.5 h.

hypotheses.check: Retrieve batch records with product, media, feeding schedule and inoculation density for both runs.
